def transform(grid):

    def is_solid(vals):

    # find separator rows/cols

    sep_cols = [j for j in range(w) if is_solid([grid[i][j] for i in range(h)])]
    if sep_cols:

        b = min(sep_cols)
        out = [row[:b] for row in grid]
    else:
        b = min(sep_rows)
        out = [row for row in grid[:b]]
    return [[2 if x != 0 else 0 for x in row] for row in out]
